verdict.rationale: Square documents a first-party Terminal API (terminal-api/overview) with checkout options such as an on-terminal tip screen before the buyer signs, and says payments can be processed on Square hardware. The evidence shows a documented terminal checkout API but not the server-driven flow itself. missing for 10: explicit documentation that backend calls create and push checkouts to the terminal, device pairing, checkout status and callback handling, and independent or hands-on corroboration of a custom POS built on it.
